comment: The Tam-Tara Deepcroft's last boss (BNpcBase 76, 1332316): 6329 HP, level 16; it casts 971 (0.7 s) every 3.1 s and barely moves (at most 14 yalms in three runs), 988 every 26 s (damage and a small drain: 5-10 back on retail), 987 every 63 s (a 4.7 s cast, status 17 for 20 s on its target). From Bob's Chronofoil captures of the Tam-Tara Deepcroft (2026-10-24): one run with Duty Support (3ec702a8, visit 0.3) and two Duty Finder runs (cc26e0ea, visits 0.2 and 0.4), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the three runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
